name: Vetropack Holding AG
summary: Vetropack Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and distributes glass packaging products in Switzerland, Austria, the Czech Republic, Croatia, Slovakia, Ukraine, and Italy. It offers glass bottles and jars. The company serves the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries. Vetropack Holding AG was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Bülach, Switzerland.
